question: How do pot and cloth differ, from each other, others, and me?
premises: This pot and this cloth are two mutually differing.
And those two differ even from me.
inference: Pot and cloth exemplify threefold difference: mutual, inter-knower, and from-me.
plain_english: This pot and this cloth — the two differ mutually, differ from another knower too, and those two differ even from me.
